office_does: The treasurer collects Kitsap County's money, including property taxes, pays it out on the auditor's warrants, and invests county and special-district funds.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Pete Boissonneau (Prefers Democratic Party), in office since 2023, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Kitsap County Treasurer since 2023, previously the office's chief deputy and investment officer and a fixed-income broker. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected treasurer in 2022 as the only candidate; in office since 2023 [S1][S2]
Says an insured cash sweep program he set up has earned the general fund more than $2 million [S1]
Endorsed by the Kitsap County Democrats and 26th LD Democrats [S1]
